subject: Mayor Michael McGlynn Farewell Address
overview: Mayor Michael McGlynn delivered his final State of the City address after 28 years in office, reflecting on Medford's financial stability, major development projects, and public investments. The event featured civic acknowledgments, musical performances, and blessings from local religious leaders.

items.title: Opening Acknowledgments
items.summary: City Solicitor Mark Rumley welcomed attendees and recognized city staff, educators, first responders, board members, and department heads.

items.title: Pledge of Allegiance, National Anthem, and Invocation
items.summary: Romeo Robbins led the Pledge of Allegiance, Renise King performed the national anthem, and Reverend Noah Evans delivered the invocation.

items.title: State of the City Address
items.summary: Mayor Michael McGlynn presented his final address, detailing accomplishments in brownfield remediation, transit-oriented developments, municipal finances, public safety upgrades, and new school facilities.

items.title: Recognition of Staff and Family
items.summary: Mayor McGlynn expressed gratitude to his long-serving mayoral office staff, city administration colleagues, and family members.

items.title: Benediction and Farewell Reception Announcement
items.summary: Geshe Tenley offered a Tibetan blessing and Mark Rumley concluded the ceremony with directions to a farewell reception.
